notes: Printed: 'Flash (You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant.) Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent's turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' It is the opponent's turn: the Cutthroat is flashed in from hand (casting it does not trigger itself: it was not on the battlefield), then another spell (Raise the Alarm) is cast on that turn: one +1/+1 counter.
